root_cause_label: spec_neglect: agent never read or applied the requirement that main branch must be served from /var/www/html (not /var/www/html/main), building all subsequent Nginx config and hook logic on the wrong directory layout
one_sentence_failure_summary: At step 10 the agent created /var/www/html/main instead of using /var/www/html as the main-branch document root, locking in an incorrect deployment path that propagated through the Nginx configuration and post-receive hook while the agent never performed an end-to-end test to discover the mismatch.
t_err_evidence: Step 10 command: 'mkdir -p /var/www/html/main /var/www/html/dev' — agent creates /var/www/html/main as the main-branch serve directory instead of /var/www/html, violating the requirement that https://localhost:8443/index.html must serve from /var/www/html/index.html.
t_commit_evidence: From step 10 onward, the agent builds everything (Nginx root at step 18, post-receive hook at steps 23/28) on top of /var/www/html/main; it never revisits or corrects this path choice, so the failing outcome is locked in from the moment the wrong directory is chosen and the agent proceeds without correction.
trigger_explanation: The task required the main branch to be served from the web root /var/www/html (so https://localhost:8443/index.html maps to /var/www/html/index.html), while dev maps to /var/www/html/dev/index.html. The agent never consulted or correctly applied this path requirement and instead invented a symmetric /var/www/html/main layout that violates the main-branch endpoint specification.
